interpretation_notes: Applies when building_type is farm_house. 'Minimum 7.50 meters open space (MOS) from all sides' is checked against the smallest of the four entered setbacks. 'Such other conditions as may be imposed by the authority' cannot be encoded and is shown as a note.

notes_en: The authority may impose other conditions.
notes_hi: प्राधिकारी अन्य शर्तें भी लगा सकता है।

source.quote: In any area designated for agricultural use, Farm Houses shall be permissible subject to the following conditions and such other conditions as may be imposed by the authority

checks.explain_en: Farm houses are permissible only in areas designated for agricultural use (Rule 17).
checks.explain_hi: फार्म हाउस केवल कृषि उपयोग हेतु निर्धारित क्षेत्र में अनुमत है (नियम 17)।

source.quote: (a) Minimum size of the plot shall be 0.40 hectare;

checks.explain_en: Minimum plot size for a farm house is {required} hectare (Rule 17(a)).
checks.explain_hi: फार्म हाउस के लिए न्यूनतम प्लॉट {required} हेक्टेयर है (नियम 17(a))।

checks.explain_en: Maximum FAR for a farm house is {required} (Rule 17(b)).
checks.explain_hi: फार्म हाउस के लिए अधिकतम FAR {required} है (नियम 17(b))।

notes_en: The rule requires a sloping roof.
notes_hi: नियम के अनुसार ढलवाँ छत आवश्यक है।

source.quote: (c) The maximum height of structure shall be 7.5 meters with sloping roof;

checks.explain_en: Maximum height of a farm house structure is {required} m with a sloping roof (Rule 17(c)).
checks.explain_hi: फार्म हाउस की अधिकतम ऊँचाई ढलवाँ छत के साथ {required} मी. है (नियम 17(c))।

notes_en: Trees must be on the plot before the building application is made.
notes_hi: भवन आवेदन से पहले पेड़ प्लॉट पर होने चाहिए।

source.quote: (d) Farm House shall have a minimum of 100 live trees per hectare on the plot before the application for building constructions is made to the Authority;

checks.explain_en: A farm house plot needs at least {required} live trees per hectare (Rule 17(d)).
checks.explain_hi: फार्म हाउस प्लॉट पर प्रति हेक्टेयर कम से कम {required} जीवित पेड़ आवश्यक हैं (नियम 17(d))।

source.quote: (e) Farm House shall be accessible by road having width not less than 7.5 meters;

checks.explain_en: The access road must be at least {required} m wide (Rule 17(e)).
checks.explain_hi: पहुँच मार्ग कम से कम {required} मी. चौड़ा होना चाहिए (नियम 17(e))।

source.quote: (f) Farm House shall have minimum 7.50 meters open space (MOS) from all sides.

checks.explain_en: A farm house needs at least {required} m open space on all sides (Rule 17(f)).
checks.explain_hi: फार्म हाउस के चारों ओर कम से कम {required} मी. खुली जगह आवश्यक है (नियम 17(f))।
